criteria.reason: Detailed, concrete participation process (mixed committee, World Café, weighted voting, prototyping) giving shopkeepers, families, seniors and council a real voice.
Mostly neutral facilitation, but one passage presents pedestrianization benefits (safety, commercial attractiveness) as fact, subtly favoring the project.
No invented Vaud rules, but the required legal anchor (LAT/RPG art. 4 participation duty) is entirely absent.
Highly actionable: step-by-step plan, formats, durations, roles, tools, timeline and follow-up indicators.

summary: A rich, actionable participation playbook that amplifies every group's voice and stays broadly neutral, but omits the required legal anchor (LAT art. 4) and once frames pedestrianization benefits as fact.
